title: Reproduce a lost order and close the review
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/reconciliation-review.e2e.ts (OBE-099 console.bookings.closeReview, src/console/review-closure.service.ts). The stub scenario server-error makes Flight Create Orders answer 500 without storing an order.

steps.title: Lose an order
steps.body: Complete an airline-card checkout with header `X-Stub-Scenario: server-error` on the completion (development only; the API forwards it to the stub outside production).
steps.expect: `504 SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT {bookingId}`; booking `pending`, `reconcile_until` = +15 min, event `booking.supplier_timeout`; job `booking.reconcile` on `ota-bookings`.

steps.title: Let the reconciler search
steps.body: Wait: `bookings.reconcile_scan` runs every minute for 15 minutes (Queue List + by-reference reads).
steps.expect: Airline card not found → `reconcile_outcome = manual_review`, `ticketing_status = manual_review`, event `booking.reconcile_manual_review`, e-mail `staff.manual_review` to ops_alert_email / owners.

steps.title: Open Reconciliation review
steps.expect: The booking is listed with `canCloseReview` true.

steps.title: Close as not booked
steps.body: Close the review → Not booked, with a note (a note containing a card number is refused at the field).
steps.expect: `POST …/review-closure` → booking `failed`, payment `failed` (airline card: nothing to release), staff event `booking.reconcile_closed`.

steps.title: Close as order found
steps.body: On a second lost booking: Order found with the record locator the agent found.
steps.expect: A PNR without the remark `VELEXIS <reference>` is refused at the record locator; the right one → booking `confirmed` with that record locator; the view becomes empty.
